inputs.name: noise_map
inputs.note: noise map; expected to be constant over the frame (sigma/255)

runtime_hints.note: FastDVDnet supports a range of noise levels; this pack represents a moderate sigma preset.

origin.notes:
This ONNX file is expected to be a StudioCast-compatible export of the upstream PyTorch model (FastDVDnet forward(x, noise_map)).

Input expectations:
- noisy: [N, 15, H, W] float32 RGB in [0..1] (5 contiguous frames concatenated)
- noise_map: [N, 1, H, W] float32 in [0..1] (sigma/255)
- H and W should be multiples of 4 (or pad/crop like upstream temp_denoise).

This pack is a template (no binaries are committed).
